entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I, uh, I need to return something. It's the Urban Commuter Helmet I bought.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I get your full name and order number?
Yes, it's Mark Shapiro, order number VF77819. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I just... I really needed this to work out.
I see the order, Mr. Shapiro. Thank you. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken or anything. The box is unopened, still sealed. It's just... the color. It looked different online, and now it just sits there reminding me I spent money I probably shouldn't have. I was really hoping to get that back.
I understand that seeing an item in person can be different. I do want to assure you that the helmet's primary feature is its top-tier safety rating, regardless of the shade.
I know, I know safety is important, but... I just feel so disappointed every time I look at it. With things being so tight, I just... I really need the money back for bills.
I completely understand, Mr. Shapiro. Let me just check the purchase date here... Okay, I see you received it 42 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.

Alright, I've checked our system. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 42, you are well within the window. We can absolutely process this return for you for a full refund.
Oh! Really? Oh, thank you so much, Sarah. That is such a huge relief. I was so worried. Thank you.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. You've really helped me out today. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
